description: Replace default-browser styling with Pico CSS v2 (classless framework). Add the stylesheet to base.html, add viewport meta tag, wrap body in a container, and tweak templates where needed. Mobile-friendly layout — forms stack on narrow screens, tables scroll horizontally where needed. Keep progress bars (budget bars) custom-styled since Pico doesn't ship bars. Preserve existing functionality: HTMX category select, flash banners, filter forms, inline edit forms. Light overrides for the brand color and dashboard-specific layouts.
title: UI overhaul with Pico CSS, mobile-friendly
